title: Ocular Shock Front in the Colliding Galaxy IC 2163
question: Do the ALMA CO velocity fields show gas streaming into the eyelids of IC 2163 that drives the pileup of molecular gas and turbulence, as predicted by encounter simulations?

evidence.quote: we take $X_{CO}$ = $1.8 \pm 0.3 \times 10^{20}$ (H$_2$ cm$^{-2}$)/(K km s$^{-1}$) from (cite: dame01)

what.value: IC 2163 projection parameters PA = 65 deg, inclination 40 deg

evidence.quote: We adopted values of the projection parameters of IC 2163 from (cite: elmegreen95a; elmegreen95b)

what.value: VLA HI cubes and velocity field

evidence.quote: We compare our CO images of IC 2163 with the VLA H I observations by (cite: elmegreen95a).

recipe.goal: Image and mask the CO cube
recipe.method: CASA clean with natural weighting, then 6'' smoothed 2.5-sigma mask with two-channel continuity, primary-beam correction, subcube

recipe.goal: Make moment maps and convert to column density
recipe.method: Moment maps from subcube; blank where I(CO) <= 200 Jy/beam m/s; N(H2) from X_CO

recipe.goal: Measure velocity differences across eyelids in face-on polar coordinates
recipe.method: Deproject with PA = 65 deg, i = 40 deg, nucleus center; measure Δv between outer and inner edges at fixed θ, averaged over 4 pixels (9.3 deg); dv/dR = Δv/(sin i)/ΔR
key_parameters: eyelid edge at I(CO) = 200 Jy/beam m/s; minimum Δv uncertainty 7 km/s
assumptions: Δv_z negligible across the eyelid width (nearly in-plane perturbation)

recipe.method: Linear regression of N(H2) on |dv/dR| for 25 azimuth points (and the northern eyelid alone)
Second-moment dispersion, corrected for mean velocity gradient across the PSF; compared with single-Gaussian fits to unmasked line profiles

answer_key.quantity: Regression N(H2) vs |dv/dR|, all 25 points: slope

evidence.quote: The correlation coefficient is 0.84 with 23 degrees of freedom

answer_key.quantity: Radial streaming at θ=270 on northern eyelid (in-plane)

evidence.quote: equivalent to $\Delta v/\sin i$ =$171 \pm 40$ km s$^{-1}$ in the plane of the disk

answer_key.quantity: Corrected CO velocity dispersion, northern eyelid
Corrected CO velocity dispersion, NGC 2207 arms west of bar

evidence.quote: the mean $(\sigma_v)_{\rm corr}$ $\pm$ rms scatter is $10 \pm 10$ km s$^{-1}$

not_stated_but_needed: tclean/clean parameters: niter, threshold, clean masks, and the interactive vs automatic choice
Velocity grid and spectral line-free channels; continuum subtraction method not described
Exact rest frequency used for velocity conversion
AIPS tasks and parameters for moment maps and polar transformation
Procedure to compute the beam-gradient velocity dispersion correction
Whether the Hanning-smoothed channels were regridded to 10 km/s
missing_for_reproduction: AIPS procedures for polar transformation and dispersion correction
score_reason: Public data, with a clear measurement recipe and table of results, but imaging parameters and AIPS steps are underspecified.
rediscovery_reason: Public data and numeric tables (Table 2, regression) allow redoing the analysis, though some steps are loosely described.
